notes: Warn before the GENERATE / re-render flows when VOICEVOX is needed but not running — previously you only found out from an error buried in the render log. The 'VOICEVOX isn't running' pre-check existed but only guarded startBatch() (Text to Video). The main GENERATE button (scenesRerender) and rerender() emit 'render-only', whose server handler runs generate-audio-voicevox.js and fails (exit non-zero → 'Audio generation failed') when the engine is down — with no upfront warning. Extracted the check into a shared async voicevoxPreflightOK() and called it in scenesRerender() and rerender() (both now async, returning early if the user cancels) plus refactored startBatch() to use it. Detection is now via projectUsesVoicevox(), which mirrors the server's contentUsesVoicevox(): true when the global voice is VOICEVOX OR any scene sets its own voicevoxSpeaker — so the warning also fires for per-scene VOICEVOX use, which the old startBatch-only check missed. Reuses the existing vv_warn_* i18n + confirmVoicevoxWarning modal (Start anyway / Cancel). Verified in-browser by stubbing /voicevox-status down: warning shows on GENERATE; Cancel aborts (no render-only emitted); Start anyway proceeds; projectUsesVoicevox returns true/false correctly for global and per-scene cases; no console errors.
